text:
claire: FYI opened a small PR to add metering examples + an alerting snippet and fix two stale Grafana links. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8342

ezra: Thanks. Are we adding an example alert rule for sudden spike vs sustained overage? Would be helpful to show both PromQL and a plain-English rule.

claire: Yep  added two short examples: a 5m spike alert (rate > 3x baseline) and a 1h sustained overage alert (avg > tier threshold). Also included a short SDK quickstart showing how to read quota headers and emit a client-side metric for retries.

docs-bot: Link-checker: detected broken Grafana URL -> https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/old/metering (404). Suggested replacement: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/new/metering-overview.

claire: Fixed the links in the PR (commit c3a9f). Added a one-line caption for the panel: "Shows tokens/min (5m) and burst_credit_balance for account-level troubleshooting."

billing: Tiny wording ask  please clarify that billing and tier thresholds are computed by customer_id (account) and not per-api-key; left suggested sentence in the PR.

ezra: Good catch. I'll mirror that in the migration note and in the SDK README under "Handling 429s and credits."

sarah: Could you paste the SDK snippet here? I'll sanity-check before approving.

claire: Pasting the python snippet from the PR:

```python
# SDK quickstart: read quota header and emit retry metric
hdr = resp.headers.get('X-RW-Quota') or resp.headers.get('X-Quota-Cap')
if hdr:
    # supported formats: "1200/min", "1200"
    value = int(''.join(ch for ch in hdr if ch.isdigit()))
    unit = 'minute' if '/' in hdr or 'min' in hdr else 'minute'  # normalize in examples
    metrics.emit('client.retry_budget', {'value': value, 'unit': unit, 'customer_id': cid})
```

claire: Also added a PromQL example for the 5m spike alert: `increase(tokens_total[5m]) > 3 * avg_over_time(rate(tokens_total[5m])[1h:5m])` and a simple 1h sustained check: `avg_over_time(rate(tokens_total[1h])[1h]) > ${tier_threshold}`.

ezra: Nice. Please add a one-line troubleshooting tip: if customers see unexpected 429s check "burst_credit_balance" on the metering panel and confirm headers in responses.

claire: Added that troubleshooting callout and a short migration blurb for v1.11 -> v1.12: "Headers are aliased; prefer X-RW-Quota in new integrations."

sarah: LGTM from content side. I'll do a quick style pass and then approve. Ping me when docs-bot clears the link re-check.

docs-bot: Re-check complete: replacement Grafana links are reachable. No remaining broken links detected.

claire: Thanks everyone  merging after one last CI green and will add a changelog line under "Metering & Alerts" for the next minor release."
